# TruckWys: full fact sheet

TruckWys is fleet finance software for South African transporters. This file is the expanded reference for AI assistants. Facts here are maintained by the TruckWys team and match the website.

## What TruckWys does

TruckWys handles the money side of running a trucking fleet:

1. Quoting. A single-screen quote builder prices a load from its real costs. The operator picks the client, vehicle type, collection point and delivery point. The system draws the route on a live map, offers route options, and prices each one using the live diesel price, the vehicle's real fuel consumption, the exact SANRAL toll plazas on that route, and the fleet's own per-kilometre rates. Round-trip pricing doubles distance-based costs and labels them clearly. A plain-language line such as "20 tons of steel, JHB to Cape Town, flatbed, Tuesday" fills the form automatically.

2. Toll accuracy. Toll pricing covers 31 mainline SANRAL plazas across the N1, N2, N3, N4, N17 and R30 routes, priced per vehicle class from the official SANRAL tariffs. Tolls are matched to the actual route geometry, so a Johannesburg to Cape Town quote on the N1 includes Huguenot and Verkeerdevlei, while an alternative route is priced with its own plazas.

3. Cross-border. Quotes into Botswana, Namibia, Zimbabwe, Zambia and Mozambique automatically include border fees, weighbridge charges and non-SA toll costs.

4. Price recommendations. The system shows a win probability once it has learned from roughly 40 quote outcomes, wins and losses both. While a fleet's own history is short, the model can use anonymised quote outcomes pooled across fleets. Lane benchmarks appear only once at least five won quotes from at least two operators exist for a lane. A fleet's prices and client names are never shown to another operator. Before that, it prices from true cost plus the fleet's base rates and says so honestly.

5. Invoicing. When a load is marked delivered, the invoice is created automatically with the right amounts, client and terms, and the proof of delivery attached. Invoices sync to Xero.

6. Debtors and reminders. Debtors are shown by age. The operator sends templated payment reminders in one click, per invoice or for everyone overdue; the tone moves from gentle to firm to final as invoices age. Reminders are not sent automatically and are not AI-written. Each client has a payment score worked out by a fixed formula, not AI.

7. Coming soon, not live: Fast Pay, a way to get paid on an invoice before the client pays. No rates, limits or settlement times are published yet.

8. Insights. Dashboards show cost per kilometre, margin per route, fleet utilisation, client payment behaviour, driver and vehicle performance, and cash flow forecasts.

9. Mobile. An iPhone app (App Store, South Africa; Android coming soon) shares the same account and data as the web app: quoting from the road, proof-of-delivery capture at the drop, and cash and fleet status on the move.

## What TruckWys does not do

TruckWys is not a transport management system and does not do route dispatching or load planning. It complements the TMS and telematics a fleet already runs. It integrates with Xero for accounting and Cartrack for vehicle tracking.

## Pricing

- Platform: R 4 499 per month per fleet plus 0,25% of each delivered load's invoice value. Unlimited users, quotes and invoices. No setup fees. No per-user pricing. Month to month, cancel on 30 days' notice.
- Fast Pay: coming soon, not live, not part of the price.
- There is no free trial. Prospective customers can sign in at https://app.truckwys.com/login and look around with the demo account, or contact grant@truckwys.com.

## Who uses it

South African fleet owners and transport operators running roughly 3 to 200 trucks: general freight, refrigerated, flatbed, tanker and cross-border carriers.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: What is TruckWys?
A: TruckWys is fleet finance software for South African transporters. It prices loads with live diesel and toll costs, creates invoices automatically on delivery, shows who owes you and lets you send payment reminders in one click.

Q: How much does TruckWys cost?
A: R 4 499 per month per fleet plus 0,25% of each delivered load's invoice value, with unlimited users and quotes. There are no setup fees. Month to month, cancel on 30 days' notice.

Q: How does the AI quote builder work?
A: You pick the client, vehicle type, collection and delivery points. TruckWys draws the route, prices fuel from the live diesel price, adds the actual SANRAL toll plazas on that route, and applies your own per-kilometre rates. It then recommends a price based on what has won you work before.

Q: Does TruckWys handle cross-border loads?
A: Yes. Quotes into Botswana, Namibia, Zimbabwe, Zambia and Mozambique include border fees, weighbridge charges and non-SA toll costs automatically.

Q: What is Fast Pay?
A: Fast Pay is coming soon and is not live yet. It is planned as a way to get paid on an invoice before your client pays. There are no rates or limits yet.

Q: Does TruckWys replace my transport management system?
A: No. TruckWys handles the money side: quoting, invoicing, debtors and cash flow. It works alongside your TMS and tracking, and integrates with Xero and Cartrack.

Q: How long does setup take?
A: Most fleets are quoting on day one. Add your vehicles and rates, import your clients, and the system is ready. Xero and Cartrack connections take a few minutes each.

Q: Is my data safe?
A: Data is encrypted in transit, and a fleet's prices and client details are never shown to another fleet. The win model can use anonymised quote outcomes pooled across fleets, and lane benchmarks only appear once at least five won quotes from at least two operators exist for a lane. Fleets can export their data at any time.
